855-2292-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
855-2292-5254.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

6495-6529-7084.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-6529-7084.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1379-5413-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
1379-5413-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter as an artifact land creature due to Encroaching Mycosynth and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 2 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Trenching Steed.

549-6798-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
549-6798-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, you lose 1 life and create a 2/2 artifact creature token.
The earthbending creature enters as an artifact land creature due to Biotransference and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 4 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Umbral Collar Zealot.

2021-2060-3129-7741.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

2685-3197-3263-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2685-3197-3263-6824.description:
Gain life in any way.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2946-3967-4871-6255.notablePrerequisites:
A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
You have max speed.
2946-3967-4871-6255.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Zahur trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3532-4842-5078-7753.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Chasm Skulker triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3249-5686-6586.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Vivi.
Cast Vivi by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Havengul Lich triggers, causing it to gain Vivi's activated abilities until end of turn.
Resolve Vivi. Then, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Vivi.
Activate Havengul Lich using Vivi's ability by paying {0}, adding at least {2}{U}{R}.
Repeat.
3249-5686-6586.notes: If Havengul Lich's power is 5 or higher, you'll get infinite red and blue mana.

2816-3809-4917-5184.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two other artifact creatures.
2816-3809-4917-5184.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature, creating three Treasure tokens due to Xorn.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Activate Jan Jansen by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature, creating three Treasure tokens due to Xorn.
Activate Jan Jansen by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Treasure, creating two 1/1 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Activate Jan Jansen by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
2816-3809-4917-5184.notes: Once you have infinite mana and Treasure tokens, you can use Jan Jansen's second ability, paired with untapping it, infinitely to get infinite Construct tokens.

944-1824-2530-7349.manaNeeded: {B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
944-1824-2530-7349.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
944-1824-2530-7349.description:
Cast Acererak either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Diamond Mare triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

2054-2440-5685.description:
Activate Propagator Drone by paying {3}{G}, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Eldrazi and Spawn you control.
If needed, activate Urn of Godfire by paying {2}, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2054-2440-5685.notes: You should only perform step 3 if you have no {G} available. The initial mana cost can be reduced if you control additional Eldrazi and/or Spawns.

1874-5670-6705.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
1874-5670-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

967-3809-6441-6798-7087.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

3532-4908-5078-6608.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Jace's Projection triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

4186-6798-6872.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
4186-6798-6872.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1110-6785.description:
Cast Devastating Onslaught by paying {10}{R}, creating five token copies of Terror the Peaks.
The Terror of the Peaks tokens enter the battlefield, triggering the nontoken Terror of the Peaks five times, and each Terror of the Peaks token four times.
Resolve all Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing 125 damage divided among a maximum of 25 targets.
1110-6785.notes: Paying {10} while casting Devastating Onslaught is a recommendation. You can pay more or less depending on what mana you have available and how much damage you wish to deal. {10} allows three opponents to be dealt at least 40 damage.

1251-1350-4010-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1251-1350-4010-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

856-4321-5256-6351.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4321-5256-6351.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Teval trigger.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

4616-5256-6249--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
4616-5256-6249--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1652-5004-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Patron of the Arts and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Patron of the Arts dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Cathodion from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Cathodion and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Patron of the Arts from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

116-950-5329.description:
Activate either of the creatures by tapping it, targeting the other creature.
If the tapped creature was a Merfolk, Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the ability from step 1, untapping the targeted creature.
Repeat.

1117-2034-3689-5346.notablePrerequisites: One of the artifact creatures must be on the battlefield, with the other in your graveyard.
1117-2034-3689-5346.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the artifact creature dies, it and Crime Novelist trigger.
Resolve the artifact creature's trigger, returning the other artifact creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Crime Novelist trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast the artifact creature from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2082-3967-4186.easyPrerequisites: Sadistic Glee attached to Scurry Oak.
2082-3967-4186.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature
2082-3967-4186.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies, Sadisitc Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

864-1741-1770-1987.notablePrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
864-1741-1770-1987.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Eternal Witness and Cloud of Faeries.
When Eternal Witness and Cloud of Faeries enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger twice each.
Resolve the first Eternal Witness trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second Eternal Witness trigger, returning any other instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Cloud of Faeries trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Resolve the second Cloud of Faeries trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.

2253-3129-4688.description:
Cast Army of the Damned by paying {5}{B}{B}{B}, creating 26 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.

148-2651-4869.notablePrerequisites:
An additional card in hand.
The number of cards in library is greater than each opponent's life total.
Keen Sense attached to Glint-Horn Buccaneer.
148-2651-4869.description:
Activate Murderer's Axe's equip ability by discarding a card, targeting any creature.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Keen Sense triggers for each opponent dealt damage.
Resolve one trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Holding priority, repeat.
Repeat.

1528-2539-3616.notablePrerequisites:
Dual Casting attached to any creature you control without summoning sickness.
A permanent that can tap for {R}.
1528-2539-3616.description:
Cast Toils of Night and Day with any targets.
Pay {R} and tap the creature enchanted with Dual Casting to copy Toils of Night and Day, targeting the creature enchanted with Dual Casting and a permanent that can tap for {R}.
Twinning Staff triggers, creating a copy of Toils of Night and Day.
The copy targets at least the permanent.
Allow the first copy of Toils of Night and Day to resolve.
Tap the permanent for {R}.
Repeat steps 2-6.

618-2197-5200-5313.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Kiki-Jiki.
Your devotion to green is at least seven.
618-2197-5200-5313.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to create a token copy of Nylea's Disciple with haste.
The token enters gaining you at least 9 life.
Pay 9 life to Treasonous Ogre to add {R}{R}{R}.
Pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

215-563-1909-2026-2404.notablePrerequisites: At least 1 other creature on the battlefield.
215-563-1909-2026-2404.description:
Tap Gaea's Cradle to add {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Tap Voyaging Satyr to untap Gaea's Cradle.
Return Allosaurus Shepherd to your hand with Wirewood Symbiote's ability untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Pay {G}{G} to return Wirewood Symbiote to your hand with Temur Sabertooth's ability.
Play Allosaurus Shepherd for {G}.
Play Wirewood Symbiote for {G}.
Repeat.

65-717-864-2628-4686.description:
Activate Polluted Mire's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Polluted Mire, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Polluted Mire trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Eternal Witness.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Polluted Mire from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
